name: W2-on-G1-v1
description: W2 fixed-address canonical window (with receive full-zero fix) on top of R1+M2+G1
fixture: M (prepared-v1, regenerated on Mac; S matches golden)

primary.rule: one-sided 95% upper bound of geometric mean cand/base, critical t(1-0.05/4,71); promotion requires every primary upper bound < 1

auxiliary.rule: two-sided intervals with t(1-0.05/72,71); any lower bound > 1 vetoes promotion

finality: single run; no resampling, deletion, trend removal or re-run; child timeout 20 s; any child failure aborts the screen as failed
